resources.string: Ask about what you bought at Continente. Gemini picks what to look up, and the numbers are counted on your phone from your receipts.
How much did I spend last month?
How many yogurts did I buy this year?
What do I buy most often?
Answers come from Gemini with your own key. Add it in Settings; it stays on this phone.
No Gemini key: add one in Settings.
Gemini didn\'t accept your key. Check it in Settings.
Your Gemini quota is used up for now. Wait a minute, or enable billing on the key\'s project.
Gemini is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
No connection to Gemini. Check your internet and try again.
That question needed too many steps. Try asking it more simply.
